note: Nigeria: a performing artist or entertainer comes on the Creative Arts visa (F7F), a short-stay visa for artistic, entertainment or musical performance that allows performing but no employment (Nigeria Immigration Service). No days of performing without it are named. Read through a fetch that serves the page's text, since the Service's site answers this client 403. ECOWAS citizens work as nationals do (the ecowas list).

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service, Creative Arts Visa – F7F
sources.said: Short stay visa for artistic, entertainment, or musical performance in Nigeria. ... No employment. Permitted to perform performative activities only.
